data.title: Pilot Recruitment: Refer a Friend to Earn Rewards!
data.summary: Invite your friends to join you in battle and get gifts.
data.meta_title: Pilot Recruitment: Refer a Friend to Earn Rewards!
data.content:
Take on the Wild Ten together when you invite your friends to play War Robots: Frontiers! Earn special rewards when your friends register via your unique Pilot Recruitment link.

Follow the steps below to start earning rewards! 

  1. Log in or register at warrobotsfrontiers.com.
  2. Copy your unique link from the Pilot Recruitment page.
  3. Share it with friends.
  4. Get rewards!

Instant Rewards

Receive Stickers for each friend you recruit when they log in for the first time.

Rewards can be redeemed on the Pilot Recruitment page by clicking the 'GET REWARD' button.

Tutorial Job Rewards

As your friend progresses through the Tutorial Jobs, you’ll receive +5% bonus Credits (on top of the Credits earned from the Job), and they’ll receive +25% bonus Credits.

When the referee completes all 24 Tutorial Jobs, they will officially be a Pilot, and new rewards will unlock for the referrer (you!).

Gifts For New Pilots

It’s not only the recruiter who gets rewards! The following will be granted when new players create a War Robots: Frontiers account using your Pilot Recruitment link:

  • Allison Clay (Common Pilot)
  • 3 Days of Premium
  • 2x Quantum Weapons
  • 25% bonus Credits for each Job completed

Check out the FAQ and rally your friends to War Robots: Frontiers today!
